info.name: Task Manager API Tests
info.description:
QA/SDET Portfolio — Full test suite for the Task Manager REST API.

Covers:
- Auth (JWT login)
- Positive CRUD tests with schema validation
- Negative tests (400, 401, 404)
- Boundary tests (long strings, empty fields, invalid enums)

Pre-requisite: Run `npm run seed` before executing this collection.
